title: City Roam
description: A playable third-person open-world city exploration game with walk, run, jump, collisions, day-night lighting, mobile controls, and an expandable procedural city.

defaultCaptions.x: City Roam — take the long way home in a playable third-person open-world city.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Explore City Roam: a third-person browser game built for keyboard, touch, and low-end mobile.
defaultCaptions.reddit: City Roam is a playable Three.js open-world city prototype with day/night exploration and mobile controls.
defaultCaptions.discord: City Roam — walk, run, jump, and roam one more block.
